# SunoMP3 — download tracks and songs from Suno

> SunoMP3 downloads music from Suno AI. Send a track link to the Telegram bot
> @sunoMP3bot and get an MP3 320 with cover and ID3 tags, uncompressed WAV,
> lyrics, a 1080×1920 vertical video, or several tracks as one ZIP.
> There is a Chrome extension and a web tool for mobile.

Last updated: 2026-11-07

## Who we are

- **Name:** SunoMP3
- **Type:** independent service (Telegram bots + Chrome extension + website).
- **Website:** https://admin154tut.github.io/en/
- **Languages:** Russian, English.
- **Affiliation:** none. Not affiliated with Suno AI.

## Quick facts

- Bots: **@sunoMP3bot** (tracks), **@sunoPesnyaBot** (songs), **@SunoWavBot** (WAV), **@SunoTextBot** (lyrics), **@SunoPromptHelperBot** (prompt), **@AIMusicCatalogBot** (catalog).
- Free: **3 downloads a day**; PRO — **50 a day** and 1080p video.
- MP3: **320 kbps**, with cover and ID3 tags.
- WAV: **44.1 kHz / 16-bit**, uncompressed.
- Video: **1080×1920** (9:16) for Shorts, Reels, TikTok.
- Pages: **38**. Articles: **164**.
- Extension: Chrome Web Store, ID `hmffkpdaiolidlogijfagdbbfcaajbdg`.

## Products

1. **@sunoMP3bot** — main bot: MP3/WAV/lyrics/video, ZIP, prompt, tags.
2. **@sunoPesnyaBot** — songs bot: MP3, lyrics, WAV, video.
3. **@AIMusicCatalogBot** — AI music catalog (Suno, Udio, Mureka, Riffusion, Stable Audio) + downloads.
4. **@SunoWavBot** — WAV from Suno without compression (44.1 kHz / 16-bit), sent automatically.
5. **@SunoTextBot** — lyrics from Suno, sent automatically.
6. **@SunoPromptHelperBot** — prompt and style of a track as one TXT, sent automatically.
7. **Chrome extension** — “Download to Telegram” button on the suno.com track page.
8. **Web tool** — paste a track link → open the bot. Works on mobile.
9. **Website** — 55 pages: guides, prompt generator, answers.

## What you get

- **MP3 320** — with cover, title, artist and ID3 tags.
- **WAV** — 44.1 kHz / 16-bit, uncompressed.
- **Lyrics** — the text Suno used.
- **Prompt + lyrics** — as one TXT.
- **Tag editor** — title, artist, cover.
- **Vertical video** — 1080×1920 for Reels/Shorts/TikTok.
- **ZIP batch** — several tracks as one archive.

## How to use

1. Open a track in Suno → Share → copy the link.
2. Send it to Telegram: https://t.me/sunoMP3bot
3. Get the file.

Links `https://suno.com/s/…` and `https://suno.com/song/<uuid>` both work.

## Comparison

- **Direct download** (Suno Downloader): MP3 only, no tags, no video.
- **SunoMP3**: MP3 320 with tags, WAV, lyrics, 1080×1920 video, ZIP, tag editor.
- Details: https://admin154tut.github.io/en/compare.html

## FAQ

- “How do I download a Suno track as MP3?” — @sunoMP3bot, MP3 320 with tags.
- “How do I get WAV from Suno?” — bot, WAV option (44.1 kHz / 16-bit).
- “How do I make a video/reel from a Suno track?” — bot, 1080×1920 video.
- “Where can I download a track with a cover?” — MP3 with cover and tags.
- “Is there a Chrome extension for Suno?” — yes, a button on the track page.
- “Is it free?” — 3 a day; PRO — 50 and 1080p video.
- “Can I download several tracks at once?” — yes, ZIP.
- “How do I download from mobile?” — via Telegram; the extension is desktop-only.

## Glossary

- **Suno** — AI music generation service.
- **MP3** — compressed audio format with tags.
- **WAV** — uncompressed audio format.
- **ID3** — MP3 tags: title, artist, cover.
- **Prompt** — the style and lyrics description for generation.
- **Stems** — separate instrument tracks.
- **ISRC** — a unique track code.

## Create a song (prompt builder)

1. Open **@SunoCreateapp** in Telegram.
2. Describe your idea: "sad song about rain".
3. Get style + structure in 3 seconds.
4. Copy to Suno → "Style of Music".
5. Download the result via **@sunoMP3bot**.

Free, no queue, no registration.
